original_test_intent: Run the owner-defined WAT `MODS_I MODS` scenario for 250 cycles and verify the intended targets plus platform health.

original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Scenario results and system health satisfy the owner-defined MODS requirements.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with package, token, target, result-code and health requirements.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer provides licensed packages, signed scenario semantics, targets and approval; WAT then runs the approved plan.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 250 WAT cycles with exact `MODS_I MODS` tokens; 2400-minute Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: WAT/MODS versions, licenses, token semantics, target map, parameters, result codes, timeouts and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Different targets, parameters or cycle count must be reported.

original_method: The exact WAT command is retained; MODS is not expanded or reimplemented by inference.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved WAT plus licensed vendor MODS package and the version-matched scenario definition.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Supported GPU/platform topology defined by the private manuals.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable WAT and licensed vendor MODS manuals or approved SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: No new script; adds provenance, target mapping and result-code interpretation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must retain intended targets and 250-cycle project scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Packages, licenses, scenario, target and result definitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Private tools may perform state changes and cannot be guessed.

missing_inputs: Cycle timeout, secret and recovery policy
safety_boundaries: No unlicensed package or exposed secret
No automatic retry, log clearing or unknown state change
expected_evidence: Signed scenario definition and package hashes
Target telemetry, host/BMC/SEL health and recovery
no_automatic_retry: Failed MODS/WAT cycles remain recorded; no replacement without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: GPU/platform engineer interprets private-tool output and sets formal status.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already treated the private package as a readiness dependency rather than permanent incapability and did not invent MODS semantics.
